facts.fact: Zerouali says the monetary and banking law 23-09 (article 97) and Bank of Algeria Regulations 24-01, 24-04 and 25-02 define the framework for payment service providers and digital banks, which he calls clearly established.
facts.system: Law 23-09 and Bank of Algeria Regulations 24-01, 24-04, 25-02

facts.fact: Regulation 25-02 sets the conditions and procedure for licensing payment service providers, which are non-bank entities; Zerouali says none is yet licensed and several applications are under examination.
